scope: First release for lmi; checked before upload on 2026-10-30
method: Explicit allowlist export, fresh Git history, pinned source provenance and actual ROM payload inspection
ota_certificate: Matches the publicly available AOSP test certificate; not a personal certificate
recovery_adb_keys: Only a symlink to /product/etc/security/adb_keys; no host identity key file was found in the extracted published filesystems

known_identifier_and_path_scan.three_private_key_marker_hits: Reviewed: format-header string constants only, with no key payload in the same string

source_archive.uid_gid_names: normalized root/0; no personal archive owners

limits: Pattern scanners cannot prove the absence of every unknown secret.
Gitleaks skips binary files and files over 20 MB in the ROM scan; a separate streaming known-identifier/path/header scan covered the larger files.
Archive-aware Gitleaks inspection used one nesting level; compiled/compressed third-party code is not exhaustively semantically audited.
Public upstream copyright/author information, generic build metadata and public attribution are retained.
Functional testing is limited to the device and scenarios described in docs/STATUS.zh-CN.md.
distribution: GitHub hosts source, patches and technical documentation only; binary downloads are hosted separately.
